description.en:
Specifies whether to update the vSwitch. Valid values:

- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No.
The ID of the new vSwitch.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds change-instance-azone --drds-instance-id drdsjiii1b490000 --origin-azone-id cn-hangzhou-B --target-azone-id cn-hangzhou-A --drds-region-id cn-hangzhou --change-vswitch true --new-vswitch vsw-wz9ckkba51zrh00000000 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
